attributes.residual: PARKED at real 16 (unchanged by the semantic fix, which is score-invisible by construction). The remaining residual is a genuine reorder of the same constant-materialization cluster at +0xf0..+0x138, and NO SOUND PERMUTATION EXISTS: an exhaustive search over every relocation-consistent, form-legal complete matching of the 18-atom window (64 matchings after the fix, 32 before it) is refused by check_permutation_dependences, every one on the same obstruction - `(7, 'mem')`. The target requires our `stfs f2,lbl_80344194` store to move AFTER the `lfs f0,sCameraVisibilityRadius` load, and webfrank models all memory as ONE resource, so a store crossing a load is a barrier. The two accesses are provably distinct SDA globals (different symbols, both EMB_SDA21), so a memory-disambiguation capability keyed on distinct relocation symbols WOULD discharge it - but that is a new guard capability and belongs to the webfrank.py owner, not to a rule author. DO-NOT-RETRY: do not re-derive this window without such a capability; the search was exhaustive, not sampled.
